subject: dot argument 'save_warmup' not recognised by stan() function

messages.author: 173a608b2b8a8866
messages.subject: dot argument 'save_warmup' not recognised by stan() function
parts:
Hi

I wanted to use the argument 'save_warmup=FALSE', which is in the help described as an option for "...", to avoid saving draws during the warmup phase. However, if I use 

stan(...., save_warmup=FALSE)

I get in return the error message that 'save_warmup' is an unknown argument. Looking at the code when calling "stan" in R there is an explanation as this option is not listed in

dot_arg_names <- names(list(...))
is_arg_recognizable(dot_arg_names, c("chain_id", "init_r", 
                                     "test_grad", "append_samples", "refresh", "control", 
                                     "enable_random_init", "obfuscate_model_name"), pre_msg = "passing unknown arguments: ", 
                    call. = FALSE)

Do I need to call this option differently?

Thanks for any help!
Sereina
